impact_scope.description: The existing public function expands its valid caller-controlled vertex_uvs_stride domain from 12–256 bytes to 8–256 bytes, introducing valid 8-byte UV records.

evidence: S0 already declares meshopt_generateTangents with caller-supplied UV data and vertex_uvs_stride.
H0 never calls meshopt_generateTangents, so the existing callable and its S0-valid input domain are unexposed.
S0 rejects vertex_uvs_stride values below 12, so an 8-byte UV-record case was not a valid S0 obligation.

gap_after.type: direct API exposure gap with expanded input-domain obligation
evidence: S1 retains the same meshopt_generateTangents declaration and changes the minimum vertex_uvs_stride from 12 to 8.
H0 remains unchanged and still never calls meshopt_generateTangents.
Reaching the changed S1 semantics requires H0 to supply an 8-byte-stride UV buffer and vertex_uvs_stride=8.

new_harness_obligation.description: In addition to exposing the already-omitted meshopt_generateTangents API, H0 must now construct a valid two-float-per-vertex UV buffer and call the function with vertex_uvs_stride=8; that caller-supplied value and buffer layout were invalid and unnecessary in S0.
evidence: vertex_uvs and vertex_uvs_stride are direct caller inputs, so H0 must explicitly construct and supply the newly valid case.

reason: The same public callable is omitted by H0 before and after, so its direct exposure gap persists. However, S1 concretely expands the caller-visible valid input domain to 8-byte UV strides, requiring a new H0-supplied value and matching buffer construction to expose the changed behavior. The degenerate-tangent default and size_t cast are internal behavior changes and do not independently create another harness entry or call obligation.
